QProcess transport and serial terminal ownership

decision: Extend compatible Task/EngineBus adapters and logical workspace admission; preserve existing shared pool, queued GUI relays and native-drain ownership
requested_features: Opt-in generic callable adapter and progress callback/task context
Opaque task IDs and task/result/error/finished/progress envelopes
Bounded safe error tuple with no live traceback retention
preserved_contracts: Existing submit/dispatch call signatures and legacy signal payloads
Default admission semantics and shared aggregate cap
Existing cooperative cancellation and GUI lifecycle
Provider and GPU admission, Chroma storage bins and SQLite authority
Creative owner/CAS, editor journal and reviewed source pins
gaps: No generic progress/task ID/workspace quota in current Task
Task callable does not automatically receive cancellation event
Declared TASK_TIMEOUT_S not enforced in Task.run
String error public/diagnostic separation requires new policy
Workspace fairness and owner/revision commit gates need caller-specific adapters
phases: Logical workspace admission and bounded progress
One harmless caller migration then separate release/pin review
acceptance: GUI receiver thread identity and explicit queued slots
Progress payload/rate bounds, coalescing, terminal delivery
Exactly one terminal outcome and no finish-as-drain shortcut
Real pool/child/helper join before owner destruction
No model/provider/private-store use in synthetic qualification

Admission/ownership, queue removal, joins and blocking destructor
Runnable ownership, autoDelete and reuse race
Asynchronous child transport and blocking-wait boundary
